stem:
Students build a balloon-rocket car using a balloon, a straw, a water bottle, and some tape. When the straw is released by a student, the air from the balloon comes out. A diagram of the car is shown.

Which statement best describes the motion of the car when the straw is released?

options.label: A
options.text: The car will move away from the wall in the same direction as the air that is leaving the balloon.

options.label: B
options.text: The car will move toward the wall because of the force of the air from the straw.

options.label: C
options.text: The car will move fast because the straw gets light as the air is released.

options.label: D
options.text: The car will not move because the air escapes from the balloon.

visual_elements: diagram of balloon attached to water bottle car with hand holding straw
